title: Global AI Regional Network Atlas
subtitle: Regional co-occurrence networks in AI-related news, 2016–2025
working_paper: Measuring Global AI Cooperation, Competition and Innovation through News Text: A Graph-based Approach
data_note: A link connects two ADM1 regions when both are mentioned in the same filtered AI-related news document. Link weight is the number of unique documents in which the pair co-occurs. Co-occurrence is an observational news-text relation and is not, by itself, evidence of direct collaboration or competition.
geography_note: All ADM1 units in the supplied global boundary file are retained in the public map. The source contains 3,224 polygon features representing 3,223 unique country–ADM1 name pairs; the duplicate Mazandaran geometry is combined into one public ADM1 unit. Regions without network activity in a selected year remain visible with value 0.
